meta.name: The Messengers 720p
meta.description:
When a mysterious object crashes to Earth, a group of seemingly unconnected strangers die from the energy pulse, but then awaken to learn that they have assigned the task of preventing the impending Apocalypse.

Rated TV-14 · Canceled · First aired 17 Apr 2015 · United States of America · Language: English · 40 min
Studio: Thunder Road, Warner Bros. Television, CBS Studios · Network: The CW

Not complete. On your server: S1 12/13 (missing E10)

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: Awakening
videos.overview: In the white-hot sun of the New Mexico desert, scientist Vera Buckley watches in fascination as a mysterious object plummets to Earth and explodes in a blinding flash, sending out a shock wave that briefly stops Vera’s heart and panics her techie coworker Alan Harris.

videos.title: Strange Magic
videos.overview: Drawn together by destiny, Vera, Erin, Joshua, Raul and Peter convene together where they meet the mysterious Rose. Rose reveals that they are angels and their mission is to find and stop the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse from bringing about the Rapture. Meanwhile, The Man’s real identity is revealed and he continues to tempt Vera with clues about her missing son.

videos.title: Path to Paradise
videos.overview: On the hunt for the Horseman of War, Joshua, Erin and Peter make great strides for the group. Raul and Vera are more hesitant to believe and when they stray, there are unforeseen consequences. But when Vera discovers her gift, she finally starts to rethink her purpose.

videos.title: Drums of War
videos.overview: The friends need to identify the Horseman of War and his victim whilst at an international energy summit.

videos.title: Eye in the Sky
videos.overview: Erin wants peace as Amy celebrayes her birthday. Joshua tries to jumpstart his visions.

videos.title: Metamorphosis
videos.overview: As the fully united Messengers work to track down the Second Horseman of the Apocalypse, Alan and Vera continue their quest to uncover the genesis stone’s secrets. Meanwhile, Erin begins to discover the price of her gift.

videos.title: Deus Ex Machina
videos.overview: As the Messengers race to stop the next Horseman, they uncover a cyber plot to kill thousands. Meanwhile, Joshua finds he can no longer escape his past.

videos.title: A House Divided
videos.overview: The Messengers struggle to stay together and on mission when an unforeseen setback causes them to question whether being an Angel is causing them more harm than good. In the process of pursuing their own desires, the Messengers discover that destiny has a strange way of bringing them back together.

videos.title: Death Becomes Her
videos.overview: The Man informs the Messengers one of their own has betrayed them and another is in imminent danger, while Amy's drawings predict the arrival of someone who could change the course of everyone's destinies.

videos.title: Harvest
videos.overview: Based on contradictory clues, the Messengers make clashing predictions about who will be the Horseman of Famine. Meanwhile, Vera almost unearths the Horsemen's master plan.

videos.title: Spark of Hope
videos.overview: The Messengers' powers are tested as they attempt to rescue someone from government lockup. Meanwhile, Joshua has a vision foreshadowing the arrival of a deceptive new adversary.

videos.title: Houston, We Have A Problem
videos.overview: A battle between the Messengers and the Four Horsemen takes place as the Horsemen try to break the fifth seal in the series finale.
